description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Popup_Picker' responsible for handling popup interfaces for contacts in a CRM system. It includes methods for generating address and merge popup pages, handling user input, and rendering list views with contact data.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate contact popup and merge pages in the CRM, with functionality for address handling and contact list display.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs an SQL WHERE clause based on request parameters for filtering contacts.

methods.name: process_page_for_address
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML content for the address selection popup, including contact list view and address forms.

methods.name: process_page_for_merge
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML content for the contact merge popup, including contact list view and search functionalities.
